acceptanceCriteria: dogfood prepare output lists the modified paths that are not citable, or a plan-check verb validates a citation plan against the diff without binding.
All refused rows are reported in one pass with their reason codes.
Measured over a batch: first-attempt bind refusals for citation rules drop to 0.
body: Friction observed 2026-10-18: 3 of 4 lanes this batch (PR #1090, #1095, #1098) had their first dogfood-finish refused because the citation plan cited a file or span the change modifies (cite-span-not-stable, cite-self-modified-authority under CEM-V1-114). Each refusal costs a full prepare/bind cycle (minutes, plus a lane retry budget of 2). The rule is only discovered at bind time. Expected: prepare (or a cheap `cem cite --check-plan`) emits the set of citable paths (unmodified by BASE..HEAD) and validates a draft plan before the expensive bind, naming every bad row at once.
title: dogfood prepare should list citable sources up front; lanes lose a bind attempt to cite-self-modified-authority / cite-span-not-stable
